description: Use this when the user names a kind of binder rather than listing titles (estate planning, trust, exhibit 1-25, medical chart, HOA, IEP, audit workpapers, real estate closing, and many more): returns Tabzoola's ready-made tab sets matching the query, each with its section titles in order, tabs per set, the page that describes it, the exact price for 25 sets (paper, collated, 3-hole punched, setup included) and an orderUrl that opens the designer pre-filled. Read-only; purchases nothing. Pass the titles to draft_order or quote_price for other quantities or options.

query.description: Words to match against set names, uses and titles, e.g. "estate", "exhibit", "hoa", "chart". Omit to list sets.

name: list_named_sets
title: List Tabzoola's named tab sets
